Description: The power supply unit is operating normally.

The power supply unit continues to operate, but warning events have been
detected. These include over-temperature, high power, over-current events, or
degraded fan speed.

• The AC cord is disconnected or AC power has been lost while the second power
supply still has AC input power. Ensure the AC cord is securely connected to the
inactive unit.
• A power supply unit failure has occurred. Verify input voltage.
